FAQs

Does this serum help with pigmentation on the face?

Yes. It's formulated with 3% Tranexamic Acid and 7% Niacinamide, which work on two different stages of the pigmentation process — TXA interrupts the trigger, Niacinamide blocks melanin transfer to the skin's surface. Together they target pigmentation, dark spots, and post-acne marks with regular night-time use.

Is this good for dark spots on the face caused by acne?

Yes. It's specifically designed for stubborn post-acne marks — the dark spots that stay behind after a pimple has healed. 3% Tranexamic Acid works on this exact type of pigmentation, while 20% Black Rice Extract calms and protects the skin as it repairs.

Will this serum treat hyperpigmentation, or just lighten temporarily?

It targets the root causes of hyperpigmentation rather than masking it. TXA and Niacinamide work on the pigment-forming pathway itself, so results build with consistent use rather than fading once you stop applying it.

Can it help with dark marks and black patches on the face?

Yes — dark marks, black patches, and stubborn spots from old acne or sun exposure are exactly what this serum is formulated for. Visible improvement in tone and clarity typically shows with consistent nightly use over several weeks.

How is this different from a regular niacinamide serum?

Most niacinamide serums use it alone. This one pairs 7% Niacinamide with 3% Tranexamic Acid, targeting pigmentation from two ends of the pathway instead of one. It's also delivered in an ActiveHold™ jelly base that stays on skin longer overnight for better absorption than a quick-absorb watery serum.

Is it suitable for sensitive or acne-prone skin?

Yes, it's suitable for all skin types, including oily and acne-prone skin. The jelly texture is lightweight and non-greasy, and Black Rice Extract adds antioxidant support without clogging pores.

How long before I see results on dark spots and pigmentation?

Pigmentation takes time to fade since it works below the skin's surface. Most users see visible improvement in tone and spot clarity with consistent nightly use over 4 to 8 weeks, alongside daily SPF use.

Can I use this every night?

Yes, it's designed for nightly use as the last step before your night cream, applied to a freshly cleansed face.

Do I need to use sunscreen with this?

Yes, daily SPF is essential when treating pigmentation and dark spots — without it, new pigmentation can form and undo progress, since UV exposure is one of the main triggers this serum works to interrupt.
